title: We used to live here
goal: Talk about past habits and how things have changed with -ArdY.

intro.text: Add `-dY` and the past endings to the general present `-Ar`: *okardym*, I used to read; *giderdik*, we used to go. The negative is `-mAz`: *okamazdym*. Put it beside *indi* (now): *Öň bu ýerde ýaşardyk, indi Aşgabatda ýaşaýarys.*

exercises.question: How do you say **I used to read a lot**?

why.1: *okadym* states a plain past, **I read**. For a habit you used to have: *okardym*.
why.2: *okaryn* is the general present: **I read (as a rule)**.

exercises.label: *işlemek* with `-ArdY`: I used to work, you used to work…
exercises.explain: The final *e* of *işle-* becomes *ä* before *-r*: *işlär-*, then *-di* and the past endings.

exercises.text: Öň biz bu ýerde ýaşa___, indi Aşgabatda ýaşaýarys.
exercises.en: We used to live here; now we live in Ashgabat.

reject.why: *ýaşadyk* is the plain past, **we lived**. For **used to live**: *ýaşardyk*.

accept: My grandfather used to keep sheep.

exercises.prompt: We used to go to the village every summer.

reject.why: *gitdik* is **we went**. For a habit in the past: *giderdik*.

exercises.explain: *git-* softens to *gid-* before the vowel of *-er*; then *-di* and *-k*.

exercises.text: Öň men kofe iç___, diňe çaý içerdim.
exercises.en: I didn't use to drink coffee; I only drank tea.

reject.why: *içmedim* is **I didn't drink** (once). For a habit: *içmezdim*.
The negative of `-Ar` is `-mAz` in every person: *içmezdim*.

accept: As a child I used to eat a lot of sweets.
When I was a child, I used to eat a lot of sweets.
As a child I ate a lot of sweets.
When I was a child, I ate a lot of sweets.
As a child I used to eat lots of sweets.
When I was little, I used to eat a lot of sweets.

exercises.label: *okamak* with `-ArdY`, negative: I didn't use to read…
exercises.explain: `-mAz` in every person, then *-dy* and the past endings: *okamazdym*.

exercises.text: They used to live in a village.
accept: They used to live in the village.

exercises.prompt: Did you use to live in Mary?

reject.why: *ýaşadyňmy?* is **did you live?**, a plain past. For **used to**: *ýaşarmydyň?*

exercises.prompt: Öň bu ýerde bazar bardy, indi ýok.
accept: There used to be a market here; now there isn't.
There used to be a market here, but now there isn't.
There was a market here before; now there isn't.
There was a market here before, but now there isn't.
There used to be a market here, but not any more.
There used to be a market here; now there isn't one.
